vendor.title: AI job search tips: 9 AI tools to help you land your next job
vendor.teaser: From writing your resume for you to automating networking emails, there are tons of ways AI can help streamline your job search. But more importantly, AI can also help you cut through the noise, secure interviews, and impress hiring managers—as long as you use it well.

vendor.title: TutorMoments: Do AI tutors know when to help and when to hold back?
vendor.teaser: A preview of TutorMoments, a framework and dataset for evaluating LLM tutors on when to help or hold back in math tutoring, is released with accompanying code, data, and a preview paper.

vendor.title: Firebird Launches CIS Region’s Largest AI Factory in Armenia
vendor.teaser: The global buildout of AI infrastructure reached a new milestone today — Firebird, an emerging AI cloud, launched the CIS region’s largest AI factory in Armenia, establishing a new AI computing hub powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing and Dell Technologies high-performance AI infrastructure.

vendor.title: How Autotorino automated lead intake and inbound call capture with Zapier and Salesforce
vendor.teaser: Autotorino manages sales and after-sales across 74 locations and 23 brands, with customer requests arriving through web forms, lead-gen tools, email, and a high volume of phone calls.

vendor.title: Grok Imagine Image 2.0 now available on Vercel AI Gateway
vendor.teaser: Grok Imagine Image 2.0 from xAI is now available on Vercel AI Gateway as a preview, an image generation and editing model that plans typography and layout together and renders small text sharply.

vendor.teaser: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB now lets you create and manage your own backups and restore your data on demand. vendor.teaser: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) R8i and R8i-flex instances are available in the Europe (Milan) region.

vendor.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore adds memory, policy, and harness in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
vendor.teaser: Today, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore introduces new capabilities in AWS GovCloud (US-West). AgentCore is the platform to build, connect, and optimize agents.

vendor.teaser: New Vercel Pro subscriptions include a free domain for the first year, available on six TLDs and claimed at checkout or from the dashboard within 30 days.

stories.title: China empowers Global South nations through AI technology
stories.teaser: China launched two artificial intelligence-powered satellites from Shandong Province that will provide remote sensing services to Uzbekistan and Indonesia. One satellite will monitor Uzbekistan's cotton production through its complete cycle, while the other will track crop growth and assess disaster risks in Indonesia.

stories.title: Did a robot write that? Study suggests people prefer AI authors
stories.teaser: Researchers at Villanova University conducted a study examining how people perceive and rate artificially intelligent writing compared to human-written content. The study involved participants ages 18 to 81 who read short stories and rated their quality and engagement.

stories.title: 11th BRICS culture ministers' meeting concludes in Madhya Pradesh; Bhopal Declaration adopted
stories.teaser: The 11th BRICS Culture Ministers' Meeting took place in Bhopal, India, and concluded with the adoption of the Bhopal Declaration. The event brought together representatives from ten BRICS member countries, including Brazil, China, Egypt, Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Iran, Russia, South Africa and the United Arab Emirates, along with four partner nations.

stories.title: US Court Orders Meta To Pay $567 Million For Teen Mental Health Fund
stories.teaser: A New Mexico state court has ordered Meta to pay $567 million into a teen mental health fund and make significant changes to how Facebook and Instagram operate for young users. Judge Bryan Biedscheid ruled that Meta created a public nuisance by designing addictive products and failing to protect children from sexual exploitation.

stories.title: Senate advances children online safety bills, porn age verification measure fails quorum
stories.teaser: The Senate Commerce Committee advanced four children's online safety bills in a single markup, the long-debated Kids Online Safety Act, the Youth AI Privacy Act, the Children's Artificial Intelligence Toy Safety Act, and a fourth measure aimed at chatbot-style AI products marketed to kids, reflecting a shift toward regulating AI companions and toys alongside social media. A separate bill from Senator Mike Lee…

stories.title: 12 Value-Added Courses at Chandigarh University Uttar Pradesh, AI, Business Analytics & More to Boost Student Skills
stories.teaser: Chandigarh University Uttar Pradesh has introduced 12 new value-added courses into its academic program to help students develop skills beyond their main degree. The credit-based courses cover areas including Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Design Thinking, and Internet of Things, along with subjects in biotechnology, entrepreneurship, sustainable development, and sociology.

stories.title: Meta ordered to pay $567 million in New Mexico for teen mental health fund
stories.teaser: A New Mexico court has ordered Meta to pay $567 million into a teen mental health fund and implement youth safety measures on its platforms. Judge Bryan Biedscheid ruled that Meta created a public nuisance by designing addictive products and failing to protect children from sexual exploitation.

stories.title: Why 3D Spaces Interior Designing Company is Leading the Future of Home and Office Design with Advanced Technology
stories.teaser: 3D Spaces Interior Designing Company is using artificial intelligence, virtual reality, and augmented reality to transform how homes and offices are designed and furnished. The company employs AI to analyze customer preferences and optimize space usage, achieving an 80% initial design match with client needs.

stories.title: A-I Policy Forum Launches to Give Everyday Americans a Voice in Deciding the Rules for AI
stories.teaser: A new organization called the A-I Policy Forum launched in August 2026 to give ordinary Americans input into federal artificial intelligence policy. Founded by Alex Roark, a former Federal Communications Commission official, the forum brings together public advocates, government leaders, and policy experts to create community-driven guidelines for AI development.

stories.title: New Orleans Confirmed AI Answered 911 Calls for Three Years Without Caller Notice
stories.teaser: New Orleans has been using artificial intelligence to answer 911 calls for three years without informing callers, a practice confirmed by city officials in August 2026 after social media attention forced disclosure. The system, developed by Carbyne and now owned by Axon Enterprise, routes calls from people near already-reported accidents to an AI voice agent instead of human dispatchers.

stories.title: New Orleans Using AI to Answer 911 Calls
stories.teaser: New Orleans has begun using artificial intelligence, built with emergency-call software firm Carbyne, to help its 911 center handle a narrow category of calls, reports that duplicate an accident dispatchers already know about. The system was trained on real recordings of local callers so it recognizes area accents and street names.
